create_MetadataBuffers: create MetadataBuffers to allocate and manage metadata tensors for disaggregated KV cache transfer
build_get_kv_class: build get_kv_class to dispatch transfer backend classes like MooncakeKVSender or MoriKVReceiver by backend enum
test_poll_and_all_reduce: test poll_and_all_reduce to synchronize KV transfer status across distributed TP and CP ranks via gloo all-reduce
summarize_filter_kv_indices_for_cp_rank: summarize filter_kv_indices_for_cp_rank to filter global page indices to the subset belonging to the current CP rank
run_page_indices_to_cp_rank_page_indices: run page_indices_to_cp_rank_page_indices to map global KV page IDs to the local slice assigned to a specific CP rank
